whisper.definition: The act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially without vibration of the vocal cords; the sound thus produced.

whistles.definition: A device designed to be placed in the mouth and blown, or driven by steam or some other mechanism, to make a whistling sound.

who.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

why.definition: The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.

wife.definition: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

wife’s.definition: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

window.definition: An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

wine.definition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.

wipes.definition: To move an object over, maintaining contact, with the intention of removing some substance from the surface. (Compare rub.)

with.definition: A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withdraws.definition: To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

won’t.definition: Will not (negative auxiliary); used to indicate a future non-occurring action.

woods.definition: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

wool.definition: The hair of the sheep, llama and some other ruminants.

word.definition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

words.definition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worn.definition: An adjustable dam placed across a river to regulate the flow of water downstream.

worry.definition: To be troubled; to give way to mental anxiety or doubt.

worse.definition: To issue a command; to tell.

worth.definition: Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wrangling.definition: To convince or influence (someone) by arguing or contending.

wrapping.definition: A sharp blow with something hard.

wrathfully.definition: In a wrathful manner; with anger; angrily.

wringing.definition: Often followed by out: to squeeze or twist (something moist) tightly so that liquid is forced out.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writes.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writing.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

yawning.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

yawns.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

year.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

years.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.
